Tax invoice INV-1004 issued by Harbour Timber Co for goods supplied against PO-1004. Amounts are in Australian dollars and are exclusive of GST. GST is shown at 10 percent. Please pay the GST-inclusive total within fourteen days and quote INV-1004 on the remittance.

Goods: 10 metres of hardwood stud. Delivery was to the Brisbane yard. This document is synthetic demonstration data.
